method: Pillow RGB pixel comparisons on fresh native-size Chromium stage PNGs. For each sprite state, painted coverage is the pixel set changed by plate-on relative to same sprite state with plate-off; this counts exact color, antialiasing, border, and in-crop shadow. Exact color is exact RGB equality to CSS team color.
